content_sections.heading: About NHSRC Consultant - Human Resources
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) acts as a technical support institution under the National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The organization collaborates closely with MoHFW and States for health systems strengthening, supporting interventions across eight core divisions. Working with a transdisciplinary team at NHSRC provides a unique opportunity to contribute to public health administration, human resources for health, and universal health coverage at scale.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed by the notification. Only full-time regular bachelor's degrees (minimum 3 years) and full-time regular postgraduate qualifications (minimum 2 years) are considered. Diploma, certificate, executive programmes, and qualifications obtained through distance, online, part-time, or correspondence modes are not considered. Only post-qualification experience is counted. Essential Qualification & Experience: Graduation in any stream along with a regular MBA in Human Resources from a recognized university/institution with a minimum of five (5) years of post-qualification work experience in Recruitment & other HR functions. Desirable Qualifications: Diploma/Certification in Computer Application covering MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, database management, and Access; Diploma/Certification in Business Management; working experience in Government / Social Sector; knowledge and experience of governmental recruitment, documentation, filing & correspondence process in Human Resource Management; excellent verbal & written communication skills; ability to complete multiple tasks under pressure and be a team player. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fee offered is within the band of Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/- per month, commensurate with qualification and experience. In addition to remuneration, consultants are entitled to free accidental insurance, subsidized medical insurance, mobile bills reimbursement, laptop reimbursement (as per NHSRC policy), 30 days consolidated leave, fully paid maternity leave (for female consultants) as per Government of India policy, performance-linked increments, and TA/DA and per diem for on-duty visits. The initial contract remains valid until 31st March 2028, with further extension subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Consultant - Human Resources Job Description

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Consultant - Human Resources
content_sections.text: Candidates are requested to fill the online application correctly which is available on the NHSRC website (http://nhsrcindia.org). Applications will be accepted in the prescribed online application format only. The last date for receiving applications is 11th November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates selected in this interview could be considered for other vacant positions at NHSRC requiring similar skill sets and at an appropriate level. If the recruitment process includes a written test, a minimum qualifying mark will be 70%. In case 2 or more candidates qualify with the same marks, all such candidates will be considered.
